note: The helper stock's ids and gifts: one copy, read by src/net/helpers.ts, the win checker (functions/checker/build.rs) and tools/server/make-config.mts, and held to gem-backend-game-config.yaml by tools/server/helpers-check.mts. Prices are the config's alone. `daily`: the helper the daily puzzle's first win of the player's day pays, by weekday, Sunday first. `bundles`: the bundles (the creator, 2026-11-01; in Coins since 2026-11-10, when the Arcade dropped Gems), in shop order: each recipe's id and what it grants of each helper (every grant refused at the cap); `once`: max_uses 1, ever; `coinsUnframed`: a stand-in price for a page with no config (the play-test tool), held to the config's Coins price by helpers-check. `vip`: Gem Arcade VIP gives helpers (the creator, 2026-11-01, after Jade Match; docs/vip.md), paid by the win checker on its {"v": 1, "what": "vip_gift"} call: `daily`, a gift of each day of the player's week, Monday first (ISO: the player's own date, from the platform), once a date; `welcome`, once a membership, `welcomeEnd` the progression recording the end day (days from 1970-01-01) of the membership last welcomed; `dayMark` the one recording the day last given its gift (the platform answers a reused order key as a success that changed nothing, so the key alone cannot say a gift was paid before). Every gift is clamped at the cap.
